state: Owner authorized only the remaining blockers for PR #4069 integration. separateScopePlan.importantLimit: The 94 overlapping clone groups are not 94 independent refactors. Many normalize distinct declarative schemas or literal lookup data; inspect semantics before introducing an abstraction.

batches.risk: low to moderate; fixtures and measurement rulers still affect gate truth
batches.approach: Separate owned fixture data from executable orchestration where useful; reuse an existing browser fixture helper for capture MIME/containment code. Consolidate metric readers only where comparison direction and names remain explicit. Do not rewrite declarations merely to change their token fingerprint.
preservation: Byte-identical fixture inputs, corpus digest, all metric names/directions and thresholds.
Same evidence files, stylesheet/producer hashes and strict page-error assertions.
verification: Real baseline/current CSS and context preservation producers.
Context budget evaluator negative fixtures; capture containment and browser smoke tests.

batches.risk: medium; normalization, provider identity, binary decoding and Git/resource handling have different contracts
batches.approach: Locate existing owning helpers first. Move only proven-equivalent normalization/decoding code into its owning dependency layer; retain domain-specific state transitions and error mappings. Compare original and candidate outputs on boundary and hostile inputs before reuse.
preservation: Provider fingerprints, path semantics, binary-frame rejection, response payloads and resource cleanup.
All 173 retained serial protocols keep their ordering, limits and cancellation.
verification: Affected complete provider, voice, Git and knowledge suites.
Retrieval quality/faithfulness, architecture and negative boundaries.

batches.risk: high; inbound resource and error boundary
batches.approach: Review adapters to the existing bounded reader; preserve each route cap, local error type/status mapping, draining and cancellation behavior. No second body-reader subsystem.
preservation: Empty body, exact cap, cap plus one byte, multipart chunk boundaries and invalid JSON.
Rejected input never resumes privileged processing; error responses and body-free diagnostics retain their contract.
verification: Complete bounded-request-body tests plus a per-route compatibility matrix.
Malformed/oversized/aborted/erroring stream tests, activity-log inventory and error-observability gates.

batches.risk: medium to high; user editor state and asynchronous query ownership
batches.approach: Reuse the existing wire-position/result projection for definition/reference/type-definition resolvers while leaving capability, document ownership and cancellation checks explicit.
preservation: Current root/document/version, locations, stale-result rejection and empty-result behavior.
Manual editing, focus, dirty-buffer protection and existing localized native controls.
verification: Complete affected editor resolver/component suites and original five-journey Editor smoke.
UI coverage, UI typecheck/lint and original release-evidence freshness gates.

batches.risk: high; shared declaration values do not prove cascade equivalence
batches.approach: Map intentional product/reference mirrors to an existing canonical design-system source. Consolidate only with the same stylesheet order, selector specificity, media rules and complete token values. Avoid artificial selector changes that only break a clone fingerprint.
preservation: Light/dark, contrast, pointer/keyboard, reduced-motion, loading/selection/hover/focus states.
CSS custom properties, pseudo-elements, Monaco inline/vendor interactions and layout geometry.
verification: Extend the original baseline/current Chromium comparison for every moved selector/state.
Design-system SVG pixel/axe and interaction proof; UI coverage and full affected browser smoke.

batches.risk: high; declarative data and source-owned redaction contracts
batches.approach: Distinguish repeated schema syntax from distinct contracts. Reuse only existing canonical field sets where exact schema semantics agree; preserve per-operation enums, maxima, proof IDs and lifecycle meaning. Generated files are never edited by hand.
preservation: Canonical operation/schema digests and all body-free field classifications/limits.
Source-owned operation discovery, fail-closed static extraction and redaction.
verification: Regenerate the existing operation catalog, then run the complete activity-log implementation inventory.
Compare canonical schemas/digests before and after; run package/architecture/negative and diagnostics tests.

delivery: Prepare each batch as a small independently reviewable change after explicit implementation selection.
Run the unchanged Fallow 3.34.0 semantic/100-token/10-line/zero-issue gate after each batch; retain the first failure and its evidence.
No saved baseline growth, blanket suppression, lowered threshold or direct dev push.
Current Sonar PR remains blocked until the existing required gates genuinely pass; a plan is not permission to publish a red change.
